title: Disposable
text: Disposable. These are super flimsy just like a disposable straw from a fast food place. The kids were super excited but they definitely won’t last very long, very disappointing.

product_metadata.title: Color Changing Reusable Plastic Straw, Set of 24, Multicolor, Eco-Friendly and BPA Free - Made in USA
features: COOL COLORS: The color of the straw magically changes as the BPA free plastic reacts to ice cold liquid. TROUBLESHOOTING COLOR CHANGES - cold weather conditions can affect the color change. Please allow product to come to room temperature to allow for most efficient change.
REUSABLE DESIGN: An environmentally responsible choice, the straw can be reused time and again.
These color changing straws are made in the USA. EASY TO CLEAN: The color change straw is dishwasher safe, making it a low maintenance and hygienic choice.
MOOD COLORS: The original home of mood products that change color with heat, cold liquids, cold temperatures or sunlight.
PACKAGING & SIZE: Package contains 24 assorted lightweight plastic straws. The Straws are 9" Long x 0.34" Diameter.
